revisions.why: Revised 2026-11-20 (Sprint 002.42), on the owner's decision after the held-out zones: the text sets a height of 4 m for an extension in a strip whose depth it does not state (« dans une bande … inférieure au retrait défini par la règle générale »), so it is a statement in words, not a plain limit on the whole building (Sprint 002.21). It was a plain 4 m limit in the draft, a convention taken from UD d05 and wrong. Applied to the baseline and the new readings alike.
